title: Health and security scan stream, report-only
description: A weekly scan at L0/L1: gitleaks, osv-scanner (or the package manager audit), a typecheck, lint and test summary and a stale-dependency report, deduplicated by root cause. Output is a status report plus one choose card per batch proposing ledger rows whose probes fail today (re-run shows the finding gone). No suppressions, no fixes, no PRs.
acceptance: A seeded fake secret and a seeded vulnerable dependency each produce exactly one deduplicated finding
Accepting a finding creates a ledger row whose probe fails today
The stream cannot open a PR (policy denies code_write for it; test)
